DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis (Pulmonary)

The combination of a 6-month chronic cough, significant weight loss (7.5 kg), fever, night sweats, poor appetite, and a recent history of incarceration is highly suggestive of pulmonary tuberculosis. Please await the results of the Chest X-ray and consider sputum for acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear and culture.
